extraction.note: Most furniture and some bathroom titles in the source state no brand at all, so brand is null for them. No brand was guessed to fill the gap; those subcategories get their variety from type, model and price range instead.

rules: Each category and subcategory is processed independently.
The id is the original Torob random_key; a product appears in exactly one subcategory.
lowest_price_toman is the raw 'price' field, whose price_prefix is 'cheapest'.
brand is emitted only when a Torob brand-facet name appears verbatim in the title.
model is emitted only after an explicit مدل/کد marker followed by one identifier.
attributes are emitted only for values written literally in the title.
No seller offers are collected at this stage; offers is always an empty list.
